requirement_groups.purpose: Check the generation status of the video
Retrieve the shareable URL once ready

query_ground_truth.rationale: Checking the status and obtaining the final video URL are distinct steps required after video generation.

request.query: check video status and get shareable url

results.use_case: check video status and get shareable url
results.execution_guidance: IMPORTANT: Follow the recommended plan below. Extract steps before execution, adapt to your current context, execute sequentially with current_step parameter, and check known pitfalls to avoid errors.
recommended_plan_steps: Required Prerequisite (if video_id unknown): Locate the target video by listing recent videos using HEYGEN_V1_VIDEO_LIST (pick the correct identifier from returned items).
Required Step: Check the video’s processing state and key metadata using HEYGEN_RETRIEVE_VIDEO_STATUS_DETAILS (confirm it is complete/available before requesting a link).
Required Step: Request a shareable link using HEYGEN_RETRIEVE_SHARABLE_VIDEO_URL (use the returned URL as the user-facing share/download entry point).

Required Fallback (if HEYGEN_RETRIEVE_SHARABLE_VIDEO_URL returns no usable URL): Re-run HEYGEN_RETRIEVE_VIDEO_STATUS_DETAILS to confirm the video is fully processed, then retry HEYGEN_RETRIEVE_SHARABLE_VIDEO_URL once available.
known_pitfalls: [HEYGEN_RETRIEVE_VIDEO_STATUS_DETAILS] Share/download link retrieval may fail or be empty when the video is still processing; confirm completion before requesting the URL.
[HEYGEN_RETRIEVE_SHARABLE_VIDEO_URL] The returned URL is a shareable link; it may not represent a direct file download endpoint depending on how the platform exposes sharing.
[HEYGEN_V1_VIDEO_LIST] When multiple similar videos exist, selecting the wrong item leads to an incorrect identifier; validate against returned metadata before proceeding.

HEYGEN_RETRIEVE_VIDEO_STATUS_DETAILS.description: Tool to retrieve the current processing status and metadata for a specific video by ID. Use when you need to check video processing progress, get time-limited URLs for video downloads, or monitor video generation completion. Video rendering is asynchronous and typically takes 30–180+ seconds; poll at moderate intervals rather than tight loops. Verify returned URLs are accessible before surfacing to users. Note that returned URLs expire after 7 days but can be regenerated by calling this endpoint again.

video_id.description: The unique identifier of the video to retrieve status for. This ID is returned when a video is created via the video generation API.

HEYGEN_RETRIEVE_SHARABLE_VIDEO_URL.description: Tool to generate a public, shareable URL for a specific video by ID. Use when you need to create a public link that allows anyone to view the video without authentication. The generated URL can be shared with anyone and does not require HeyGen account access. Generated URLs may be time-limited; call this tool again to refresh the link if it expires.

video_id.description: The unique identifier of the video for which to generate a shareable URL. This ID is returned when a video is created via the video generation API.

HEYGEN_V1_VIDEO_LIST.description: Retrieves a list of videos associated with the user's account on the HeyGen platform. This endpoint is crucial for content management, allowing users to view and organize their video library efficiently. It provides an overview of all videos created or managed through the HeyGen service, including AI-generated videos with custom avatars. Use this endpoint when you need to display a comprehensive list of videos, manage content, or track video creation progress. The response likely includes metadata for each video such as title, creation date, duration, and status. Note that this endpoint does not provide the actual video content or detailed analytics; it's primarily for listing and basic information retrieval.

limit.description: Maximum number of videos to return per page (0-100). Defaults to 10 if not specified.

token.description: Pagination cursor token from a previous response to retrieve the next page of results.
